description:
Integrate command-center into the Director Swarm's operating loop in two ways: (1) as a complementary outcome/health signal source, and (2) as a gap monitor that drives capability development.

**Context — two complementary lenses (from brainstorming):**
- Swarm Manager = the WORK — what's being built, what's blocked, what's next, velocity, execution details. The "inside the factory" view.
- Command Center = the OUTCOMES — are subscribers growing, are scenarios healthy, is revenue moving, is the system better as a result of the work. The "looking out the window" view.
The Director needs both. Swarm Manager says "we completed 12 items and unblocked the LPBS initiative." Command Center says "and subscriber count is flat and Broadcast is 60% gaps, so maybe work should shift toward marketing pipelines."

**Team decision (from brainstorming): Director Swarm owns this, not Meta Optimization or Feature team.**
Reasoning:
- Meta Optimization was ruled out — it focuses on optimizing prompt-manager entities, not identifying missing capabilities
- Feature team is DEPLOYED to fill gaps, but SIGNAL DETECTION belongs at director level
- Director's charter is "surface blockers, dependencies, under-specified work" — gaps are exactly that
- Director already monitors stats/overview — adding outcome signals + gap checking is natural extension
- Fits deployment model: Director spots gap → proposes backlog → human approves → Feature team executes

**Implementation — outcome signals:**
- Add command-center dashboard endpoints to the Director Swarm's heartbeat (alongside existing swarm-manager overview and stats calls)
- The intelligence-officer should pull from command-center to see cross-system outcomes (subscriber trends, scenario health, visitor metrics) that inform Now/Near/Far prioritization
- Command-center data complements (does NOT replace) swarm-manager — swarm-manager gives work detail, command-center gives outcome context

**Implementation — gap monitoring:**
- Add command-center gaps CLI command (or /api/v1/gaps HTTP call) to the heartbeat checklist
- Update intelligence-officer briefing template to include a "Dashboard Gaps" section
- When gaps are found, director evaluates whether filling the gap would materially improve decision-making for any active team
- If so, propose a backlog item to build the missing data pipeline
- Gap priority weighted by: (a) which dashboard (Panorama/Mission Control gaps > secondary page gaps), (b) whether active teams currently lack that data, (c) effort to fill vs value of metric

**Files to modify:**
- Director Swarm TEAM.md — add command-center to heartbeat checklist (outcome signals + gap monitoring)
- Intelligence officer skill/instructions — add outcome signals and gap reporting to briefing template
- Document the gap → backlog → execution workflow
name: director-swarm-gap-monitoring
title: Integrate command-center as Director Swarm outcome signal and gap monitor
